3D simulation
• MX-1 is upgraded toward an F1-replica silhouette: low nose, front wing, sculpted sidepods, halo, rear wing, diffuser, suspension and slick tyres.
• Dynamic chase camera, track curbs, kerbs, lighting, shadows and scenery.
• AI opponents are intentionally slower and clearly spaced so the player has control and overtaking space.
• Throttle, brake, steering, DRS, ERS boost and camera controls are manual.
• Requires an internet connection only to load the Three.js engine from CDN.
